description: A PostHog experiment (A/B test): a feature flag with variants plus the metrics used to compare them.

Type.description: Whether the shared metric is used as a `primary` or `secondary` metric.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the experiment belongs to.

Description.description: Description of the experiment hypothesis and expected outcomes.

FeatureFlagKey.description: Key of the experiment's feature flag. Letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores only. PostHog creates the flag when no flag with this key exists; otherwise the experiment links to the existing flag as-is. Cannot be changed after creation.

FeatureFlag.description: Feature-flag config for the new flag, as a JSON object in the flag's filters shape (use Fn::ToJsonString), e.g. {"filters": {"multivariate": {"variants": [{"key": "control", "rollout_percentage": 50}, {"key": "test", "rollout_percentage": 50}]}}, "ensure_experience_continuity": false}. Applied only on create and cannot be combined with the key of a pre-existing flag. After creation, manage the flag with PostHog::FeatureFlags::FeatureFlag. Write-only.

FeatureFlagRuleId.description: UUID of the experiment rule on an existing feature flag with rules that this experiment runs on. Set only on create, together with the FeatureFlagKey of that flag.

FeatureFlagId.description: ID of the linked feature flag.

HoldoutId.description: ID of a holdout group (PostHog::Experiments::Holdout) to exclude from the experiment.

Type.description: Experiment type: `web` for frontend UI changes, `product` for backend/API changes.

StartDate.description: ISO 8601 launch time. Setting it launches the experiment.

EndDate.description: ISO 8601 end time. Setting it stops the experiment.

Parameters.description: Experiment parameters as a JSON object (use Fn::ToJsonString). Supported keys include `variant_notes` (notes per variant key) and `minimum_detectable_effect`. Flag config belongs on FeatureFlag.

ExposureCriteria.description: Exposure configuration as a JSON object (use Fn::ToJsonString), e.g. {"filterTestAccounts": true, "exposure_config": {"kind": "ExperimentEventExposureConfig", "event": "$pageview", "properties": []}}.

Metrics.description: Primary metrics as a JSON array of ExperimentMetric objects (use Fn::ToJsonString). Each metric has kind `ExperimentMetric` and a metric_type: `mean`, `funnel`, `ratio`, `quantile` or `retention`.

MetricsSecondary.description: Secondary metrics as a JSON array of ExperimentMetric objects (use Fn::ToJsonString). Same format as Metrics.

StatsConfig.description: Statistics configuration as a JSON object (use Fn::ToJsonString), e.g. {"method": "bayesian"}.

SavedMetrics.description: Shared metrics (PostHog::Experiments::SavedMetric) attached to the experiment.

ExcludedVariants.description: Variant keys to exclude from metric result calculations. Excluded variants are still served but omitted from analysis. The baseline variant cannot be excluded.

Repository.description: GitHub repository holding the experiment's feature-flag code, in `organization/repository` format.

OnlyCountMaturedUsers.description: Whether to only count users whose exposure window has fully matured.

AllowUnknownEvents.description: Skip the validation that rejects metrics referencing events not yet ingested by the project. Write-only.

Tags.description: Tags on the experiment (up to 100, 255 characters each).
